verdict.rationale: Unity ships an in-editor AI Assistant, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client and the axis applies. However, all of the MCP evidence describes Unity as an MCP server that external agents like Claude Code and Cursor connect to, either through com.unity.ai.assistant or `unity mcp`. Nothing documents the Assistant connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.
